item.title: Harnessing the healing power of therapeutic riding
item.description: On a 20-acre pasture in Greely, riding horses offers more than just physical benefits for children and adults with developmental and learning disabilities.

item.title: If we don’t help LGBTQ+ organizations now, services will disappear | Opinion
item.description: Fae Johnstone: Ottawa groups like Kind Space and the Ten Oaks Project, who provide family support and summer programs for LGBTQ+ youth, are in a tough financial position.

item.title: A little piece of Ottawa in Arnprior is causing big headaches
item.description: Ottawa owns a portion of a railway line in Arnprior. Residents say drainage is flooding their properties, and Ottawa has failed to act.

item.title: Maybe Senators' Nikolas Matinpalo will finally find some ice time with Team Finland at Winter Olympics
item.description: The 27-year-old Ottawa defenceman has been a healthy scratch for all but two NHL games in 2026, despite being chosen to represent his country in Milan-Cortina.

item.title: School buses cancelled as heavy snow expected in Ottawa area Tuesday afternoon
item.description: Snowfall of seven to 12 cm are expected Tuesday, Environment Canada said in a special weather statement. Schools remained open.

item.title: The vacant unit tax shouldn't treat people this way | Opinion
item.description: Randall Denley: Todd and Renata Gow could be facing a bill for about $37,500 in vacancy tax, even though they have done nothing out of the ordinary.

item.title: White House shines spotlight on Tkachuk brothers with Olympics social media post
item.description: Official social media account of the White House posted a video of Brady and Matthew Tkachuk talking about playing for Team USA.

item.title: MPP, city councillor call foul after vacant OCDSB school goes up for sale
item.description: MPP Chandra Pasma and Coun. Laine Johnson say the community should have a say in what happens to the former Grant Alternative School site.

item.description: There's a protocol in place for the Ottawa Student Transportation Authority, and it starts early in the day
